# T002 — Retarget Pricing to .NET 10

## Summary

Retargeted the existing project to `net10.0`; exact build and full-suite test gates passed. All ten .NET 8 test cases retained their identities and passed on .NET 10.

## Changes

- `Pricing.csproj`: Changed only `<TargetFramework>` from `net8.0` to `net10.0`; all three direct package versions remain pinned.
- `.github/modernization/a85bd646-7d62-4eb2-9a1a-e4d811643346/progress/T002.md`: Recorded changes, decisions, gates, and TRX comparison.

## Decisions

Kept `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` 17.11.1, `xunit` 2.9.2, and `xunit.runner.visualstudio` 2.8.2 unchanged: no build, compatibility, discovery, or test failure demonstrated a need to upgrade. This follows `plan.md` T002 and `assessment.md` §§ Dependencies and vulnerabilities and Build and CI. No source, test, workflow, or deployment file changed.

## Validation

- After the project edit, `dotnet build Pricing.csproj --nologo`: exit 0; build succeeded for `net10.0`, **0 warnings, 0 errors**, elapsed 2.21 s.
- After the project edit, `dotnet test Pricing.csproj --logger trx --results-directory TestResults/validation --nologo`: exit 0; **10 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 10 total**; console test duration 139 ms.
- Machine-readable `TestResults/validation/ContainerUser_RUN-A85BD6467D6_2026-10-25_06_16_14_net10.0.trx`: 10 total, 10 executed, 10 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed. Compared test names and outcomes with T001's `TestResults/validation/ContainerUser_RUN-A85BD6467D6_2026-10-25_06_14_56_net8.0.trx`: all ten match exactly, including `ReceiptUsesInvariantFormattingAndNormalizesCouponUnderFrenchCulture`. Compared also with the original `TestResults/baseline/ContainerUser_RUN-A85BD6467D6_2026-10-25_06_11_14_net8.0.trx`: all nine original cases remain present and passed. TRX files are ignored test outputs.
- Lint: n/a; none configured.

## Follow-ups and risks

T003 owns final whole-project validation and reporting. No observed compatibility or behavior regression; package-specific support lifetimes remain unverified as described in the assessment.
